results.query: OSHA interpretation NFPA 70E lockout tagout electrical hazards 1910.333(b)
results.snippet: NFPA 70E is an industry consensus standard, and is generally not enforced by OSHA. Although, compliance with NFPA 70E is an acceptable means of hazard abatement.
results.title: Lockout of tagout requirements for electrical hazards (OSHA letter of interpretation, August 5, 2015)
